title: Alcumus
text:
Alcumus is a resource on AoPS. It gives you problems tailored to your skill level. When the Alcumus bar at the top of your screen turns green, you have passed the subject and are ready to move on. When it turns blue, Alcumus thinks that you have mastered a subject. The Hall of Fame in Alcumus will show people who are skilled in Alcumus, measured by your rating. The cut point for Hall of Fame is a rating overall of 97.6. There are achievements in Alcumus which award XP upon completion. There are also quests which also award XP, but unlike achievements, specific quests are assigned. Usually, three quests are assigned at a time. If you are an AoPS friend with someone, you will be able to see their Alcumus profile.
